title: Bug: gnoi-shutdown.service Wants=pmon.service causes optics link flap during warm reboot
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

sonic-net/sonic-host-services#343 added `Wants=pmon.service` to `gnoi-shutdown.service`.
Since `gnoi-shutdown.service` has `WantedBy=multi-user.target`, systemd pulls pmon into the boot sequence before `featured` can gate it via the `delayed` flag.

During warm restart, orchagent re-applies FEC/serdes settings which bounces admin_state and toggles `host_tx_ready` in STATE_DB. Because xcvrd is already running (started early via pmon), it reacts by disabling then re-enabling the TX lanes on optics ports.

linkedPullRequests.title: Remove pmon.service from gnoi-shutdown.service Wants dependency
linkedPullRequests.author: markx-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
gnoi-shutdown.service has WantedBy=multi-user.target, so its Wants=pmon.service (added by #343) causes systemd to pull pmon into the boot sequence. This bypasses featured's delayed startup gating for pmon, allowing xcvrd to start before orchagent completes warm restart port reconciliation. When orchagent bounces admin_state to re-apply FEC/serdes settings, the host_tx_ready toggle triggers xcvrd to disable/enable TX lanes on optics ports, causing MAC_REMOTE_FAULT link flaps.

Keep pmon.service in After= to preserve startup ordering without forcing pmon to start. This is consistent with the original wait-for-sonic-core.sh (removed by #343) which treated pmon as advisory.

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/28758
